name: agent-app
description: Build skills whose SKILL.md is the program and whose bundled tool is the library: the script establishes every fact that is mechanically establishable, and the prose supplies only the judgment a script cannot. Partitions the work, designs the tool's evidence contract, and lints the seam between the two halves so a field the tool learns to emit cannot be silently ignored by the prose that was supposed to read it.
